messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: No graph annotation on Vista/Chrome
parts:
On Fri, Dec 13, 2013 at 9:09 AM, Stéphane Laurent <lauren...@yahoo.fr> wrote:
I have this error message caused by a call to ggplot() in an app: 
Error in grid.Call(L_textBounds, as.graphicsAnnot(x$label), x$x, x$y,  :  polygon edge not found

Is it related to this problem with Cairo ? This app worked very well in the past, and I have not changed anything.

Yes, it looks like this is also related to Cairo 1.5-3. See:
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/887

If you're on Linux I'd suggest installing the previous version of Cairo with:
  devtools::install_version("Cairo", "1.5-2")
You'll need the latest devtools for this. If you're on Windows, you can still install Cairo this way, but it'll be harder because you'll need to have some dependencies installed for it to compile.

-Winston
